headwords.text: To dream of a pitcher, denotes that you will be of a generous and congenial disposition. Success will attend your efforts.

Pitchforks in dreams, denotes struggles for betterment of fortune and great laboring, either physically or mentally. To dream that you are attacked by some person using a pitchfork, implies that you will have personal enemies who would not scruple to harm you.
headwords.note: 새 상징 `pitchfork`(쇠스랑). 기존 `fork`(포크)의 별칭에 있던 「쇠스랑」은 겹쳐서 뺀다

skipped_sentences.sentence: A broken pitcher, denotes loss of friends.
skipped_sentences.reason: 기존 jug의 「깨진 주전자를 봄」(밀러 Jug, 흉 — 병과 일의 어그러짐)과 같은 그림(깨진 주전자)이고 같은 극성이라 가를 수 없다
